title: Suggested: Skip visual confirmation for non-rendering tickets
description: ENG-9 (Resilient Automation API Port Binding) implemented code successfully and called implementation_done, but then failed the visual confirmation step. Visual confirmation asks the agent to verify a render, which makes no sense for infrastructure/tooling tickets. The harness should detect ticket type (epic, subsystem, or description keywords) and skip visual confirmation for non-rendering tickets (ENG, DAUD, SUGGEST epics, or tickets with no DSL/shader/scene in subsystem). This caused a 43-minute successful implementation to be marked as failed with no diff saved.
definition-of-done: Non-rendering tickets skip visual confirmation and proceed directly to quality gates
testing-plan: Run daud-worker on an ENG ticket and verify visual confirmation is skipped
